paragraphs.text: Kovria , also known as the Kovrian Wastelands or the Kovrian Barrens , is a large swath of badlands in southeastern Gulmany , part of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria .

Kovria is located southeast of the Ohran Mountains , east of Baszerat , and north of the Sea of Almaaz . This large area is covered with badlands, barrens, and wastes, including a wide plain of baked dirt, and weedy scrub.
Kovria is believed to be the former site of Terisia City .

In 3245 AR , Xantcha and Ratepe came to Kovria on a kind of forced vacation issued by Urza . After talking about the presence of Gix in Pincar City , they decided to cross the Sea of Laments and go to Koilos in the Khers , seeking answers about the Thran .
